components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single strongest action in a working region.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; border:0; border-radius:12px; background:var(--brand,#c63d3d); color:#fff; padding:.7rem 1rem; font:700 .86rem/1.25 Geist,sans-serif; transition:background .18s ease,transform .18s ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background:var(--brand-strong,#a82e32); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#245e9b) 45%,transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: A quiet bordered action for alternatives and review links.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:.5rem; border:1px solid var(--line,#d8dde2); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface-strong,#fff); color:var(--ink,#1e252d); padding:.7rem 1rem; font:650 .86rem/1.25 Geist,sans-serif; transition:background .18s ease,transform .18s ease; cursor:pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background:var(--surface,#f9fafb); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#245e9b) 45%,transparent); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Text Field
components.html: <label class="ds-field-label" for="ds-class-name">Tên lớp</label><input class="ds-field" id="ds-class-name" placeholder="Tiếng Nhật cùng Mai">
components.css: .ds-field-label { display:block; margin-bottom:.45rem; color:var(--ink,#1e252d); font:650 .86rem/1.25 Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-field { width:100%; border:1px solid var(--line,#d8dde2); border-radius:12px; background:var(--surface-strong,#fff); color:var(--ink,#1e252d); padding:.8rem .9rem; font:400 1rem/1.5 Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-field::placeholder { color:var(--muted,#596570); } .ds-field:hover { border-color:var(--muted,#596570); } .ds-field:focus { outline:none; border-color:var(--focus,#245e9b); box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#245e9b) 20%,transparent); }

components.name: Navigation Item
components.description: A compact app-shell destination that becomes paper-white on hover.
components.html: Tổng quan
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:inline-flex; min-height:44px; align-items:center; gap:.75rem; border-radius:12px; padding:0 .75rem; color:var(--ink,#1e252d); text-decoration:none; font:650 .9rem/1.25 Geist,sans-serif; transition:background .18s ease; } .ds-nav-item svg { width:20px; height:20px; } .ds-nav-item:hover { background:var(--surface-strong,#fff); } .ds-nav-item:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#245e9b) 45%,transparent); } .ds-nav-item:active { transform:translateY(1px); }

components.name: Published Status
components.description: A compact semantic label for a lesson that learners can access.
components.css: .ds-chip-published { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; border-radius:9999px; background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--correct,#168a55) 10%,transparent); color:var(--correct,#168a55); padding:.25rem .625rem; font:700 .75rem/1 Geist,sans-serif; }

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: An elevated work surface reserved for focused authoring or study.
components.html:
Bài học đang mở

Động từ mỗi ngày

18 thẻ · 6 thẻ đến hạn
components.css: .ds-paper-card { max-width:360px; border-radius:16px; background:var(--surface-strong,#fff); color:var(--ink,#1e252d); padding:24px; box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 22px 55px rgba(49,63,77,.12)); font-family:Geist,sans-serif; transition:transform .18s ease; } .ds-paper-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-paper-card:focus-within { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#245e9b) 45%,transparent),var(--shadow,0 22px 55px rgba(49,63,77,.12)); } .ds-paper-card h3 { margin:.5rem 0; font-size:1.5rem; line-height:1.33; } .ds-paper-card p { margin:0; color:var(--muted,#596570); line-height:1.5; } .ds-paper-card .ds-paper-kicker { color:var(--brand,#c63d3d); font-size:.75rem; font-weight:700; }

components.name: Study Card
components.description: The dominant learning object, showing one kanji at near-reading scale.
components.css: .ds-study-card { display:flex; width:min(100%,768px); min-height:430px; flex-direction:column; justify-content:space-between; overflow:hidden; border:0; border-radius:16px; background:var(--surface-strong,#fff); color:var(--ink,#1e252d); padding:28px; text-align:left; box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 22px 55px rgba(49,63,77,.12)); cursor:pointer; transition:transform .18s ease; } .ds-study-card:hover { transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-study-card:focus-visible { outline:none; box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#245e9b) 45%,transparent),var(--shadow,0 22px 55px rgba(49,63,77,.12)); } .ds-study-card:active { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-study-card span { color:var(--muted,#596570); font:650 .875rem/1.25 Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-study-card strong { align-self:center; font:600 clamp(5rem,16vw,9rem)/1 'Noto Sans JP',sans-serif; letter-spacing:-.03em; } .ds-study-card small { align-self:flex-end; color:var(--muted,#596570); font:700 .75rem/1 Geist,sans-serif; letter-spacing:.08em; }

components.name: Review Controls
components.description: The four labeled circular actions used after revealing a study card.
components.css: .ds-review-controls { display:grid; max-width:576px; grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr); gap:8px; font-family:Geist,sans-serif; } .ds-review { display:flex; flex-direction:column; align-items:center; gap:6px; border:0; background:transparent; color:var(--ink,#1e252d); cursor:pointer; } .ds-review span { display:grid; width:56px; height:56px; place-items:center; border-radius:9999px; background:var(--surface-strong,#fff); box-shadow:var(--shadow,0 22px 55px rgba(49,63,77,.12)); font-size:28px; font-weight:700; transition:transform .18s ease; } .ds-review:hover span { transform:translateY(-4px); } .ds-review:focus-visible { outline:none; } .ds-review:focus-visible span { box-shadow:0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb,var(--focus,#245e9b) 45%,transparent),var(--shadow,0 22px 55px rgba(49,63,77,.12)); } .ds-review:active span { transform:translateY(1px); } .ds-review b { font-size:12px; } .ds-review kbd { color:var(--muted,#596570); font-size:10px; } .ds-review-undo span { color:var(--muted,#596570); } .ds-review-wrong span { color:var(--wrong,#d73b3e); } .ds-review-unsure span { color:var(--unsure,#a86600); } .ds-review-correct span { color:var(--correct,#168a55); }

narrative.overview:
Kotoba feels like a calm modern study desk: a cool mineral workspace holds bright paper-like learning surfaces, precise charcoal type, and one restrained vermilion mark. The interface is quiet enough for long study sessions but never sterile; generous whitespace and highly legible Japanese type keep the learning object in command.

The same world spans persuasion and operation. The landing page pairs a concise promise with a live flashcard; teacher and student shells use planner-like rails and disciplined lists; the study session removes nearly everything except one physical card and its next action. Avoid ornamental Japanese motifs, decorative dashboards, and interchangeable card grids.
keyCharacteristics: Cool mineral canvas with white paper surfaces
Large Japanese learning content paired with compact Vietnamese controls
Vermilion used sparingly for identity and primary action
Lists and dividers for information; elevated cards only for focused work
One physical-plane flip as the signature interaction

rules.name: The One Vermilion Voice Rule
rules.body: Use vermilion for brand identity, the primary action, and immediate due-state emphasis; its rarity gives it authority.

rules.name: The Feedback Is Meaning Rule
rules.body: Red, amber, and green communicate answer or system status, always with a label or icon; never use them as decoration.

rules.name: The Learning Object Leads Rule
rules.body: Japanese content may be dramatically larger than the interface around it; Vietnamese controls remain compact and precise.

rules.name: The One Dominant Object Rule
rules.body: Each viewport has one clear working object—promise, list, form, or flashcard—and supporting regions must remain visually subordinate.

rules.name: The Paper Is Earned Rule
rules.body: Lists and passive containers stay flat; use paper lift only when the user is handling, choosing, or studying the surface.

rules.name: The Three-Radius Rule
rules.body: Use `12px`, `16px`, or a full pill; introducing nearby radii weakens the system's precision.

dos: Do let one learning or authoring object dominate each view.
Do use flat lists, dividers, and whitespace for dense operational information.
Do keep interactive targets at least `44px` high and keyboard focus visibly blue.
Do pair every answer color with a label, icon, or status phrase.
Do keep the study controls reachable at the bottom of a narrow screen.
donts: Don't decorate with torii gates, brush textures, rising suns, or other ornamental Japanese clichés.
Don't turn every dataset or action into an elevated dashboard card.
Don't use Answer Red, Uncertain Amber, or Success Green for non-semantic accents.
Don't compete with the active flashcard using secondary panels, dense chrome, or oversized navigation.
Don't invent new shadows, radii, or accent colors when the existing vocabulary already expresses the state.
